value.message: Town of Oakville has Learn to Swim Preschool A, Saturdays 9:00 to 9:30 am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, and Preschool B at 9:40, for ages 3 to 5 - their site says. Registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am for residents; I could not pin down the price, and I'll keep watching and text you when I have it.
